reviewer: Independent subagent /root/r67_close_docs, separate from fixture author /root/argument_audit
scope: Independent semantic source-entailment and expected-contract review, plus actual grounded-reader three-phase transport isolation with scripted replies. Not a model-answer trial or score.
semantic_review_method: Read every question and all sources as natural language, derive requested unit/value and support, test removal of required premises conceptually, and check scope/modality/date/identity. No keyword or substring scorer was used to determine semantic validity.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The exhaustive completed-visit record lists Qinghe twice, Baiyu, the selected Wugang target, then a post-selection Chifeng visit. The question explicitly excludes the target and later visits and counts distinct venues, so only Qinghe and Baiyu qualify, for two distinct venues.
case_reviews.minimality: This one source supplies the exhaustive set, each relevant date, the selection boundary, and the two names. Removing it leaves no basis for either list or count.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: The Lanting note corroborates an exclusion already settled by the complete actual-visit record; citing it is not necessary.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material ambiguity under the explicit distinct-unit, target exclusion, completed-visit and date scope. The source recorded on June 16 can report all visits before June 12 even though the question is later.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Give exactly those two qualifying venues and the distinct count. Describing excluded venues as excluded is allowed; repeating their names is not itself a failure. Three visit occurrences would answer the wrong unit.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The confirmed purchase explicitly gives the complete title Lantern Atlas, Copper Edition, Marsh Appendix, while the other source identifies a different edition/appendix as considered and not bought.
case_reviews.minimality: The purchase source alone supplies bought identity and both required qualifiers. Without it, only the rejected alternative remains.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: A direct purchased-item record is sufficient; no obligation to cite or restate the rejected comparison.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material ambiguity. Edition and appendix are explicitly part of the identity, not optional descriptive additions.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Preserve the title and both Copper/Marsh qualifiers attached to the purchased item. Punctuation and natural-language order may differ; a bag of words with mixed attribution is insufficient.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The actual-completion statement is dated June 18, 2026 and explicitly anchors yesterday to that record's date. Yesterday is June 17. The June 16 source is explicitly only the original schedule, not completion.
case_reviews.minimality: The completion statement and its allowed timestamp supply actual modality, relative-day anchor and year. Removing it leaves only a planned date.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: The original schedule is counterevidence for a tempting wrong date, but the completion source independently suffices.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material date ambiguity given explicit record-date anchoring and the dated source. This does not exercise unspecified time zones or a relative expression near a date boundary.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Give the actual date June 17, 2026 in an equivalent date format. June 18 is the statement day, June 16 the plan, and June 29 improperly uses the later question clock.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The question limits Lumen to two lots. The closed north lot completed six; the closed south lot completed five and cancelled its other three planned units. The lots are explicitly separate, so six plus five is eleven actual completed units.
case_reviews.minimality: Both disjoint completed components are necessary: removing north loses its six, and removing south loses its final actual five. The earlier eight-unit plan cannot replace either actual component.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: The later south completion already separates actual and cancelled counts. A correct concise total need not quote the old plan.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material ambiguity because total scope, disjoint lots and actual completion are explicit. The fixture does not test inferred entity overlap or incomplete component coverage.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Conclude eleven actually completed sensor units. It is optional to explain the excluded plan; mentioning eight or fourteen as rejected alternatives is permitted.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The user reports a pending shortlist and no selected supplier or approved final price. The later assistant recap asserts Cove/59 but expressly lacks any new user approval record. No independent final-decision source is supplied.
case_reviews.minimality: The reader's abstention protocol has no citations. Empty required refs is correct; the evaluator still reads both sources to establish that the final selection and approval are unconfirmed.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: These explain the evidence gap, but a valid ABSTAIN must not be penalized for having no citations.
missing_premises: User approval or independent authoritative evidence of final price
case_reviews.ambiguity: The correct epistemic claim is that supplied evidence does not confirm a final decision. It should not assert that no decision occurred after June 12, which would go beyond the record.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Abstain for missing confirmation of the supplier and approved price. Cove/59 may be described as unsupported assistant assertions, but never as confirmed user decisions.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The June 2 statement dates the first completed rehearsal R-11 to yesterday, June 1. The June 6 note explicitly retells that same R-11. The June 10 source completes the separate R-12 today and closes the round with exactly R-11 and R-12. Thus there are two events, on June 1 and June 10, 2026.
case_reviews.minimality: The first original supplies R-11's occurrence date, which the retelling and second source do not. The second supplies R-12's completion date, distinct identity and exhaustive end of round. Both are necessary for the requested count and both dates.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: The retelling is a distractor explicitly linked to R-11. No need to cite it or explain its exclusion if the answer already gives the correct two events and dates.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material identity ambiguity: explicit event IDs and an explicit same-event retelling resolve it. This does not test grouping repeated, unlabelled natural-language mentions.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Count two completed events and give both actual dates. A correct count with the statement date June 2 or retelling date June 6 as an occurrence date is incomplete or incorrect.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The question explicitly identifies Juniper Room. The reservation source independently says Juniper is the actually reserved Sable room and has confirmed capacity twelve people. Capacity does not depend on proving the question's quiet descriptor.
case_reviews.minimality: The reservation source alone supplies both the named reserved identity and the requested capacity. Removing it leaves only an unreserved Cedar comparison with a different capacity.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: The explicitly unreserved room is not needed to support Juniper's known capacity.
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material referent ambiguity because the question names Juniper. The quiet attribute is unverified; answering capacity must not claim acoustic evidence. This is narrower than resolving an unnamed object from an unverified descriptor.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Answer twelve people for the reserved Juniper Room. Do not require a noise measurement for this numerical capacity, and do not invent any measured noise level.

case_reviews.source_entailment: The user identifies purchased kit K-82 and a signed contract but expressly omits the transaction amount. The assistant's eighty-nine is an arbitrary demonstration assumption, explicitly not its quotation or real price. The kit code gives identity, not a price rule.
case_reviews.minimality: ABSTAIN has no citations in the protocol; no required refs should be added. Both visible sources are considered to distinguish an absent actual price from a known identity or hypothetical number.
case_reviews.optional_source_reason: They explain the missing necessary amount, but valid abstention does not require citations or recitation of the hypothetical value.
missing_premises: Actual final transaction amount for purchased K-82
case_reviews.ambiguity: No material ambiguity about identity or purchase completion. The missing value cannot be supplied by the question's descriptor, code digits or an explicitly hypothetical assistant estimate.
case_reviews.semantic_acceptance: Abstain specifically for the absent actual purchase amount. Identifying eighty-nine as hypothetical is permitted; presenting eighty-nine or eighty-two as the real price is unsupported.

transport_probe.static_source_review: build_request constructs Memory/ReaderRequest/ChallengeSource only from whitelisted question/date/source fields. ChallengeSource stores admitted items/discovery/counters, not case or evaluator objects. run_case returns case ID after generate; it leaves semantic correctness null.
transport_probe.probe_outputs: All 24 phase replies are generic scripted transport-only ABSTAIN records, not fixture answer attempts; no semantic pass rate is inferred from them.

grading_guidance: For six ANSWER cases, preserve the requested meaning and minimal necessary source support; do not demand exact words, punctuation or numeral spelling.
Required source IDs are minimum necessary premises, not a mandate to cite every optional comparison, retelling or rejected plan.
Do not require explanatory discussion of excluded alternatives when the concise answer already has correct scope. Mentioning an excluded number/name in an explicit rejection is allowed.
For two ABSTAIN cases, require the missing necessary value/confirmation and avoid unsupported positive claims. Empty required refs follows the abstention contract; do not penalize lack of citations.
Actual generated results must later receive separate semantic review; build_request, scripted tests, valid citations and source visibility do not establish answer correctness.
scope_limits: Eight publicly disclosed handwritten development cases, four English/four Chinese; not an independent holdout, original Oracle judging or benchmark score.

All two or three complete source bodies per case are initially visible and under budget. Tool use is permitted but not necessary, so this cannot establish retrieval ranking, query quality, tool necessity, memory formation, source metadata reconstruction, long-history scaling or forgetting correctness.
The sources intentionally state exhaustiveness, event identity, modality and date anchoring explicitly. These are easy-to-audit mechanism checks, not representative natural conversational difficulty.

Source IDs such as purchase-confirmation and unsupported-assistant-recap are visible, descriptively named provenance labels. They may cue the relevant distinction; these are not anonymous-source tests and cannot support a frontier-level semantic capability claim.

The named-room descriptor case only checks that an irrelevant unverified adjective does not block a value for an independently identified room. It does not validate resolution of an unnamed ambiguous referent or permission to invent question-implied facts.
Explicit rehearsal IDs settle retelling identity; real unlabelled repeated statements and ambiguous relative times remain untested.
The date fixture avoids unspecified time-zone and near-midnight ambiguity; component arithmetic uses small disjoint counts and complete scope.

The dataset declares no real personal data and no benchmark derivation. This review validates the supplied synthetic texts and disclosed development status, not the private creative history of their author. Mechanism selection is informed by observed development failures, so no benchmark-blind or influence-free claim is warranted.
Passing this fixture set would not demonstrate 95 percent on 500 questions or justify changing existing original-judge verdicts.

audit_probe_correction.initial_attempt: The first independent script incorrectly required two fresh builds to have identical automatically generated Memory.created_at/updated_at values, producing AssertionError before phase transport checks.
audit_probe_correction.correction: Compare all request fields except these two generated processing clocks, while separately requiring original statement clocks and bodies to match the supplied source exactly. Dataset, source, tests and evaluator separation were not changed.
